content.text: Section 24 satisfies the preferred position; no redline needed.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 sits at (indeed satisfies) our preferred position. 24.1 lets us assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or asset sale without Vendor consent (notice only). 24.2 bars Vendor from assigning, delegating material performance, or transferring by change of control without our prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, and bars assignment to a Customer competitor. 24.3 makes the consent standard for other assignments mutual and not unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed. 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration or service-reduction right on our change of control, and Sections 9 and 30 contain no competing change-of-control trigger. Two minor points short of ideal wording, noted but not redlined: the competitor bar is limited to a "direct" competitor and is subject to our own consent (a waiver we control), and 24.1 requires prompt written notice of assignment.
